description: This file defines data structures and a loader for managing session data within the OpenClaw application. It includes Codable structs for session records, a token statistics helper, session row representations, and session loading logic that fetches and decodes session data from a remote gateway, with utility extensions and error handling.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Stores default session parameters such as model and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Represents an individual session entry with metadata and token info.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response for listing sessions, including a list of session entries and metadata.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Provides token usage statistics for a session, with formatted summaries and percentage usage.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Represents a session in a UI-friendly format, including metadata, age, labels, and flags.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Represents a machine learning model available for sessions.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Holds a snapshot of the session store including path, defaults, and list of session rows.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes session data from the gateway, returning a session snapshot.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Convenience method to load only session rows.
